compute_eigenvalues_lobpcg: compute the k largest or smallest eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a symmetric matrix using LOBPCG
solve_generalized_eigenvalue_problem: solve a generalized symmetric eigenvalue problem A x = lambda B x using LOBPCG with preconditioner
batch_eigenvalue_computation: batch compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors across multiple symmetric matrices using lobpcg
track_lobpcg_iterations: track LOBPCG iteration progress by providing a callback function to monitor convergence state
run_lobpcg_with_preconditioner: run LOBPCG eigenvalue solver with a preconditioner matrix to accelerate convergence
